title: Noisiest Visitor
story: One address is hammering the login page. Which one?
goal: Write top_ip(lines): each line starts with an IP address; return the IP that appears most often.

tests.label: later winner
tests.expr: top_ip(["a x", "b x", "b x", "c x", "b x", "a x"])

hints: max(counts, key=counts.get) returns the key with the biggest value.
socratic: How do you pick the biggest count?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Noisiest Visitor”?
